# SQTradingLib Specification Catalog

- **Package Root:** `com.strategyquant.tradinglib.*`
- **Total Classes:** 893
- **Total Methods / Functions:** 14063
- **Donor Reference:** `SQX_REFERENCE_ROOT`
- **Evidence Standard:** Paraphrased clean-room specification (`contains_proprietary_source: false`).

## Overview and Architectural Responsibility

`SQTradingLib` represents StrategyQuant X's core trading, simulation, and backtesting framework. It defines the trading engine lifecycle, `StrategyBase` base classes, order execution logic, money management rules, multi-system portfolio management, and comprehensive databank performance statistics.

### `Databank`
- **Full Qualified Name:** `com.strategyquant.tradinglib.Databank`
- **Primary Job / Responsibility:** POZOR! V databanku som zmenil lock na StampedLock, ktory nie je reentrant, na rozdiel od ReadWriteLocku!   To znamena, ze ked sa v ramci jedneho threadu lockne, tak v tom istom thread se nemoze locknut znova.    Takze sa nemoze pouzivat konstrukcia ako:  funkcia1() {    lock();    funkcia2();  }    funkcia2() {    lock();    ...  }    kde obe funkcie lockuju - nastal by deadlock, pretoze ked sa vola funkcia2() tak lock uz je locknuty!  Pri ReadWriteLocku to islo, ak sa volali z jedneho threadu, teraz nie, takze je treba si dat pozor.     Ked je aktivny write lock, tak read lock caka. Takze pri aktivnom write locku (add, remove) nemozu volat  metody, ktore potrebuju read lock (getRecords() atd. a to ani z listenerov, atd.  takze listenery a properties change je treba volat az po releasnuti write locku.

### `IEvolutionaryOperator`
- **Full Qualified Name:** `com.strategyquant.tradinglib.gp.IEvolutionaryOperator`
- **Primary Job / Responsibility:** An evolutionary operator is a function that takes a population of  candidates as an argument and returns a new population that is the  result of applying a transformation to the original population.

#### Methods & Functions
| Modifiers | Method Name | Parameter Signatures | Return Type | Functional Description / Job |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `instance` | `apply` | `(arg0: List, arg1: IRandomGenerator, arg2: AbstractFactory, arg3: int, arg4: int)` | `List` | Apply the operation to each entry in the list of selected  candidates.  It is important to note that this method operates on  the list of candidates returned by the selection strategy and not  on the current population.  Each entry in the list (not each  individual - the list may contain the same individual more than  once) must be operated on exactly once.   Implementing classes should not assume any particular ordering  (or lack of ordering) for the selection.  If ordering or  shuffling is required, it should be performed by the implementing  class.  The implementation should not re-order the list provided  but instead should make a copy of the list and re-order that.  The ordering of the selection should be totally irrelevant for  operators that process each candidate in isolation, such as mutation.  It should only be an issue for operators, such as cross-over, that  deal with multiple candidates in a single operation.  The operator should not modify any of the candidates passed  in.  Instead it should return a list that contains evolved  copies of those candidates (umodified candidates can be included in  the results without having to be copied). |

---

- **Full Qualified Name:** `com.strategyquant.tradinglib.gp.IFitnessEvaluator`
- **Primary Job / Responsibility:** Calculates the fitness score of a given candidate of the appropriate type.  Fitness evaluations may be executed concurrently and therefore any access  to mutable shared state should be properly synchronised.

Whether  a higher score indicates a fitter candidate or not depends on  whether the fitness scores are natural (see {@link #isNatural}).  This method must always return a value greater than or equal to  zero.  Framework behaviour is undefined for negative fitness scores. |

### `BacktestEvaluator`
- **Full Qualified Name:** `com.strategyquant.tradinglib.gp.strategies.BacktestEvaluator`
- **Primary Job / Responsibility:** Fitness function for the genetic programming example application.  An evolved program tree is tested against a table of inputs and associated  expected outputs.  If the evolved program correctly calculates the right answer  for all sets of inputs then it has a fitness of zero.  Otherwise, its fitness  is an error value that indicates how accurate it was (the larger the combined  error value, the less accurate the function is).

### `MultiChartsSimulator`
- **Full Qualified Name:** `com.strategyquant.tradinglib.simulator.impl.MultiChartsSimulator`
- **Primary Job / Responsibility:** MultiCharts engine comments:    #1 - obchody v Tradestation sa plnia podla price. Ked napr. price klesne zo 100 na 90, a su otvorene dva short stop pending obchody: na 95 a 97,        tak najprv sa vyplni ten za 97 a potom ten za 95.       Ja to v Engine mam zatial tak, ze obchody sa checkuju v poradi v akom boli zadane. Comment #1 osetruje natvrdo situaciu, ked SL sa ma vykonat az po Stop/Limit prikaze.            #2 - to iste plati aj pre stop ordery (SL, MoveSL2BE, TrailingStop). V TS ich nastavujem vsetky sucasne, a vyplni sa ten, cez ktory prejde cena ako prva.       Musim to teda tu tiez porovnavat podla ceny.

### `TradestationSimulator`
- **Full Qualified Name:** `com.strategyquant.tradinglib.simulator.impl.TradestationSimulator`
- **Primary Job / Responsibility:** Tradestation engine comments:    #1 - obchody v Tradestation sa plnia podla price. Ked napr. price klesne zo 100 na 90, a su otvorene dva short stop pending obchody: na 95 a 97,        tak najprv sa vyplni ten za 97 a potom ten za 95.       Ja to v Engine mam zatial tak, ze obchody sa checkuju v poradi v akom boli zadane. Comment #1 osetruje natvrdo situaciu, ked SL sa ma vykonat az po Stop/Limit prikaze.            #2 - to iste plati aj pre stop ordery (SL, MoveSL2BE, TrailingStop). V TS ich nastavujem vsetky sucasne, a vyplni sa ten, cez ktory prejde cena ako prva.       Musim to teda tu tiez porovnavat podla ceny.
